verifier_note: Checked every claim against the pinned crate source itself (cpal 0.18.2, midir 0.11.0, rtrb 0.4.0, ringbuf 0.5.2, assert_no_alloc 1.1.2), read from the local cargo registry cache at those exact versions (byte-identical to the cited docs.rs source pages), plus Microsoft Learn for WASAPI/WinMM platform semantics (IAudioClient::Initialize error table, MIM_DATA message, DRV_QUERYDEVICEINTERFACE). All 20 warrant sources retrieved and individually accurate; 0 unfindable, 0 outright refuted. 4 of 10 recipes needed a correction. The systemic weakness: every recipe correctly cites 'the code does X', but several then add an uncited platform-semantic gloss on top ('because the default device changed', 'the std feature', 'try_push/try_pop', 'midiInGetDevCapsW supplies the id') that turns out to be imprecise or wrong when checked against Microsoft's own docs or the crate's Cargo.toml feature gates. Checks are honest about being compile-only where behaviour can't be observed without hardware, but one check (assert_no_alloc) omits the #[global_allocator] registration its own recipe's 'how' requires, so it demonstrates less than the prose claims.

verdicts.verify_note: cpal's error-code mapping is exact, and Xrun-input-only gotcha is confirmed (process_output has zero Xrun logic). But 'StreamInvalidated when the default device changes' is wrong per MS Learn; see corrections.

corrections.claim: 'StreamInvalidated when the default device changes' is wrong. MS Learn: AUDCLNT_E_RESOURCES_INVALIDATED fires when the stream is suspended, an exclusive/offload stream disconnects, a packaged app is quiesced, or a protected-output stream closes -- not on default-device change.

sources.note: process_input emits ErrorKind::Xrun only on AUDCLNT_BUFFERFLAGS_DATA_DISCONTINUITY; process_output has none.
Error code -> ErrorKind mapping matches exactly (lines 65-69); mapping itself is accurate.

verdicts.verify_note: Core 'what' fully sourced: rtrb lib.rs says lock-free/wait-free, alloc-once; ringbuf lib.rs literally says 'Lock-free SPSC'; SharedRb uses AtomicUsize+Acquire/Release. Two gotcha-level naming/feature claims need fixing; see corrections.

corrections.claim: 'requires std feature for HeapRb' is imprecise: alias.rs/macros.rs gate HeapRb::new() on feature="alloc" only; std enables alloc by default but alloc alone suffices. Also 'try_push and try_pop (or pop)' overstates rtrb: rtrb only has push()/pop(); try_push/try_pop is ringbuf-only naming.

sources.note: 'lock-free and wait-free'; fixed-capacity alloc on construction, no more after. Verbatim match.
SharedRb.read_index/write_index are CachePadded<AtomicUsize>, load Acquire / store Release. Confirmed.

corrections.claim: Check omits '#[global_allocator] static A: AllocDisabler', which the recipe's own 'how' and README step 2 require. Without it, assert_no_alloc(||...) compiles/runs but checks nothing -- it only proves the closure nests inside a cpal callback, not that allocation is caught.
